topic: shoulder pain on light bench loads as a compensation cascade

source.caption:
Light bench, sharp shoulder pain.

Ninety-five pounds and the front of the shoulder lights up. The lifter has no injury, no clear moment of trauma. The bench just started biting at warm-up weights and never stopped. Light weight should feel easy at warm-up. When the shoulder bites this early, the wrong tissue is doing the lift.

A bench press should be driven by the pec major with the lat stabilizing. When those go quiet, the front of the shoulder, the bicep tendon, and the upper traps step in. They were never built for the job. The first muscles to compensate are the first ones to break.

I run a simple manual test on the pec and lat before I chase the painful tissue. If they are quiet, the cascade is real. Wake the prime movers first, then earn the lift back under control.

If your bench keeps biting at light weight and stripping plates buys you nothing, send me a DM and let's wake the right muscles.

Be Good. Help Someone. Learn Lots.
